deregister_node only warns on revoke_device failure; no caller acts on device_removed:false
admit_node path 4's truncate_on_char_boundary(id, 16) can collide for short non-ASCII ids
deregister_node ambiguity branch loses structured ResolveError::Ambiguous candidates
R10 caveat duplicated in cluster/mod.rs and enrollment.rs — cosmetic

clean_areas: IdentityConflict variant correctly distinguished from Deregistered
